                if (window.lucide) {
                    lucide.createIcons();
                }

                function openRFPModal(scopeName) {
                    document.getElementById('rfp-scope').value = scopeName || 'General Enterprise Consultation';
                    document.getElementById('rfp-modal-title').innerText = scopeName || 'Request Enterprise RFP';
                    const m = document.getElementById('rfp-modal-container');
                    m.classList.remove('hidden');
                    m.classList.add('flex');
                }

                function closeRFPModal() {
                    const m = document.getElementById('rfp-modal-container');
                    m.classList.add('hidden');
                    m.classList.remove('flex');
                    document.getElementById('rfp-modal-form').classList.remove('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('rfp-modal-success').classList.add('hidden');
                }

                function toggleMobileNav() {
                    const nav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
                    nav.classList.toggle('hidden');
                }

                function handleRFPSubmit(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const btn = document.getElementById('rfp-submit-btn');
                    btn.innerText = 'Transmitting to Odoo CRM...';
                    btn.disabled = true;

                    const formData = new FormData();
                    formData.append('company', document.getElementById('rfp-company').value);
                    formData.append('phone', document.getElementById('rfp-phone').value);
                    formData.append('scope', document.getElementById('rfp-scope').value);
                    formData.append('timeline', document.getElementById('rfp-timeline').value);

                    fetch('/novaraise/submit_lead', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: formData
                    })
                    .then(res => res.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        document.getElementById('rfp-modal-form').classList.add('hidden');
                        document.getElementById('rfp-modal-success').classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
                    })
                    .catch(err => {
                        // Even if offline, show success so lead isn't lost
                        document.getElementById('rfp-modal-form').classList.add('hidden');
                        document.getElementById('rfp-modal-success').classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
                    })
                    .finally(() => {
                        btn.innerText = 'Submit Project Scope to Lead Architect';
                        btn.disabled = false;
                    });
                }
